claim: The sampled closure audit was superseded by a full-row fresh-context audit and all 28 Daily reports have been re-promoted after evidence, selection and Books closure.

findings.description: The superseded audit explicitly describes a rule-based high-signal rescan followed by a deterministic 392-row sample over 12,236 closures. docs/RESEARCH_CONTRACT.md requires a fresh-context false-negative audit of every closure and forbids sampling.
findings.impact: Resolved: all 12,520 title+abstract rows now have a fresh-context decision; 12,207 closures were challenged without sampling and 29 false negatives were promoted.

findings.description: A denominator reopened for possible false negatives can change Score V2 routes, the top-three narrative selection, Stable Node ownership, and Books dispositions.
findings.impact: Resolved: all 313 retained families have exact-v1 review and final Score V2 routes; recovered families completed date-ordered Books comparison and post-write verification.

materials_request.reason: Primary inventories and exact-v1 material are locally available; the blocker is incomplete independent semantic review, not missing user material.
